en-US.title: Venture: History Nearby
en-US.subtitle: The history of where you stand
en-US.promoText: See what's historic within a walk of you, tap it for the story, and walk straight there. About a minute each, read or listened to.
en-US.description:
The history of everything around you, a tap away.

Venture opens to what's historic within a walk of you — the landmark you're standing in front of, and the places with nothing left to mark them. Tap any of it for the story: about a minute to read, or listen while you carry on walking.

EVERYTHING NEARBY, CLOSEST FIRST

Open the app and it's already there. What's historic within a walk, each with a photograph so it's easy to spot on the street. Famous names and quiet surprises in the same list.

MORE ON WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW

The cathedral, the ship in the dock, the old town hall. The well-known things have far more to them than the line on the information sign — so take the long version: a story in chapters, a timeline you can jump around inside, and everything else that happened on the same ground.

AND PLENTY YOU DIDN'T

A prison that stood for two hundred years. A palace that burned down. A nuclear reactor running in Greenwich until 1996. Places with nothing left to show for themselves still turn up on the map, and Venture will still walk you to the spot.

ANSWERS ON THE SPOT

See something and want to know what it is? It's already in the list, one tap away. No searching, no typing, no account to set up.

WALK STRAIGHT TO IT

Pick something and go — a compass with the bearing and the distance, or turn-by-turn directions when you'd rather just be led there.

TAKE IT WITH YOU

Save whatever you fancy and it works with no signal at all: underground, on a plane, or abroad. Venture also keeps track of what you've read, so somewhere familiar still has something new in it.

BEFORE YOU EVEN LEAVE

Search anywhere and read it from the sofa — the city you're visiting next month, or the street you grew up on.

Coverage is richest in Britain and thins the further out you go. No account, no ads, nothing following you around: your location stays on your phone.
